items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: I know I studied with him, studied drums with him.

ctx.x: Did he really specialize on washboards? He played that sometime too?

No, he could play it, but Jimmy was an exceptional drummer, a good school drummer. He studied with Russick of the Tivoli Theater, a big 50-piece band out there. Russick played the timpani. I know I studied with him, studied drums with him. Jimmy took Zillophone and Tiffany from Russick. He studied with straight and many other drummers that I had. Two or three more are good top drummers I know that he studied with. And he had a very good left hand and a very good right hand. And he could read music. And he played…
I never got to hear him in person or meet him. Is he still living, do you think?
